name: parselab-ui
description: Monorepo root for parseui — drop-in shadow-DOM UI kit (CDN script + npm package), @parseui/icons, and the docs site.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@parseui/icons && npm run build --workspace=parseui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=parseui && npm run typecheck --workspace=@parselabllc/docs
